description: Source code for the 'sampledata' command in the Mattermost mmctl CLI, responsible for generating and optionally uploading/importing sample data including users, channels, posts, and profile images.

classes.name: cobra.Command
classes.description: Represents the CLI command 'sampledata' with its configuration and execution logic.

methods.name: uploadAndProcess
methods.description: Handles uploading a zip file to the server and initiating the import process, polling for completion.

methods.name: processProfileImagesDir
methods.description: Processes a directory of profile images, copying files if necessary, and returning sorted list of image paths.

methods.name: sampledataCmdF
methods.description: Main function executed for the 'sampledata' command; generates sample data, writes to file or stdout, and optionally uploads.
